```{r}

library(geepack)

library(dplyr)

library(ggplot2)


library(lme4)
library(JM)
```

```{r}

library(Hmisc)
library(lme4)
library(geepack)
library(JM)
library(survival)
library(ggplot2)
library(mice)
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)
library(gtsummary)
library(data.table)
library(broom)
library(readr)
```

```{r}
d.cd4 <- read.csv("d.cd4.csv")

d.vl <- read.csv("d.vl.csv")

```



```{r}
d.cd4 <- d.cd4 %>%
  
  mutate(
    
    patient_id = factor(patient_id),
    
    Male_y = factor(male_y,
                    levels = c(0, 1),
                    labels = c("Female", "Male")),
    
    mode = factor(mode),
    
    class = factor(class),
    
    time_yr = days.art / 365.25
  )
```


```{r}
d.vl <- d.vl %>%
  
  mutate(
    
    patient_id = factor(patient_id),
    
    male_y = factor(male_y,
                    levels = c(0, 1),
                    labels = c("Female", "Male")),
    
    mode = factor(mode),
    
    class = factor(class),
    
    time_yr = days.art / 365.25
  )
```

```{r}
cd4_brazil <- d.cd4 %>%
  filter(country == "Brazil")

vl_brazil <- d.vl %>%
  filter(country == "Brazil")
```

```{r}
head(cd4_brazil)

head(vl_brazil)

table(cd4_brazil$male_y)

table(vl_brazil$male_y)

length(unique(cd4_brazil$patient_id))

length(unique(vl_brazil$patient_id))
```


```{r}
ggplot(cd4_brazil, aes(x = time_yr, y = cd4_v)) +
  
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15) +
  
  geom_smooth(se = TRUE) +
  
  labs(
    title = "CD4 count over time after ART initiation in Brazil",
    x = "Years after ART initiation",
    y = "CD4 count"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}

cd4_summary <- cd4_brazil %>%
  
  mutate(year_group = floor(time_yr)) %>%
  
  group_by(year_group) %>%
  
  summarise(
    mean_cd4 = mean(cd4_v, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(cd4_summary, aes(x = year_group, y = mean_cd4)) +
  
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  
  geom_line() +
  
  labs(
    title = "Average CD4 count by year after ART in Brazil",
    x = "Years after ART initiation",
    y = "Mean CD4 count"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}

gee_cd4_ind_unadj <- geeglm(
  
  cd4_v ~ time_yr*class ,
  
  family = gaussian,
  
  data = cd4_brazil,
  
  id = patient_id,
  
  corstr = "independence"
)

summary(gee_cd4_ind_unadj)

```


```{r}

gee_cd4_ind <- geeglm(
  
  cd4_v ~ time_yr + male_y + mode + age + class * time_yr + cd4.baseline,
  
  family = gaussian,
  
  data = cd4_brazil,
  
  id = patient_id,
  
  corstr = "independence"
)

summary(gee_cd4_ind)
```

```{r}
gee_cd4_exch_unadj <- geeglm(
  
  cd4_v ~ time_yr* class ,
  
  family = gaussian,
  
  data = cd4_brazil,
  
  id = patient_id,
  
  corstr = "exchangeable"
)

summary(gee_cd4_exch_unadj)
```


```{r}
gee_cd4_exch <- geeglm(
  
  cd4_v ~ time_yr + male_y + mode + age + class * time_yr + cd4.baseline,
  
  family = gaussian,
  
  data = cd4_brazil,
  
  id = patient_id,
  
  corstr = "exchangeable"
)

summary(gee_cd4_exch)
```

```{r}
ggplot(vl_brazil, aes(x = time_yr, y = detect_vl)) +
  
  geom_jitter(height = 0.05, width = 0, alpha = 0.15) +
  
  geom_smooth(
    method = "glm",
    method.args = list(family = "binomial"),
    se = TRUE
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Detectable viral load over time after ART initiation in Brazil",
    x = "Years after ART initiation",
    y = "Detectable viral load: 1 = Yes, 0 = No"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
vl_summary <- vl_brazil %>%
  
  mutate(year_group = floor(time_yr)) %>%
  
  group_by(year_group) %>%
  
  summarise(
    prop_detectable = mean(detect_vl, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(vl_summary, aes(x = year_group, y = prop_detectable)) +
  
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  
  geom_line() +
  
  labs(
    title = "Proportion with detectable viral load by year after ART in Brazil",
    x = "Years after ART initiation",
    y = "Proportion detectable"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
]gee_vl_ind <- geeglm(
  
  detect_vl ~ time_yr + male_y + mode + age + class * time_yr + cd4.base,
  
   family = binomial,
  
   data = vl_brazil,
  
   id = patient_id,
  
   corstr = "independence"
)

summary(gee_vl_ind)

exp(coef(gee_vl_ind))
```


```{r}
gee_vl_exch <- geeglm(
  
  detect_vl ~ time_yr + male_y + mode + age + class * time_yr + cd4.base,
  
  family = binomial,
  
  data = vl_brazil,
  
  id = patient_id,
  
  corstr = "exchangeable"
)

summary(gee_vl_exch)

exp(coef(gee_vl_exch))
```
